text:
maria (prod): Quick sync — Helios demo next Thu wants a private-model demo with low latency. Need to align on runtime changes, infra reservation for burst, and security signoff. Who can call out blockers?

ajay (eng): I'm in. What’s the hard latency target and do we need a separate model variant?

sasha (runtime): Clarify: is the p99 target 120ms? With quantizing and 8k context we might hit ~120, but 16k pushes it higher. Also need a small runtime change for KV prefetch to stabilize warm-start perf (est 2 dev days).

kevin (infra): We have a spare staging slot Thu eve (18:00–22:00) we can reserve. Prod burst capacity that week is limited unless we commit. Need firm window.

lin (security): Heads-up: any private model artifacts require a security review (artifact scan + dataflow diagram). KMS config and audit logs will be required for private keys. Can turn around in ~48h after we get docs.

maria (prod): Customer asks p99 <= 120ms. They can accept ~200ms for the first demo if we flag it as beta, but we should try to hit 120.

ajay (eng): Proposed plan: 1) truncate to 8k context for demo, 2) quantize profile (Q4), 3) runtime KV prefetch behind a feature flag, 4) reserve staging slot + prewarm. Dev cost: 2 days + 1 QA day.

sasha (runtime): Ok — I can implement the prefetch toggle and the flag. Will need infra support for prewarm hooks and a canary flow. Also want automatic fallback to hosted model if latency/regressions occur.

kevin (infra): I can reserve Thu 18:00–22:00 in staging and add a prewarm job. I’ll need an owner for the prewarm image and a short runbook for the demo run.

maria (prod): Owners: ajay -> runtime change + PR, kevin -> infra slot & prewarm job, lin -> security docs & signoff. I’ll own customer comms and acceptance criteria. @deploy-bot please schedule a canary deploy for Wed 09:00. :pray:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: Wed 09:00 -> canary/hel-demo. Checklist created: smoke tests, latency dashboard, rollback tags.

lin (security): Send the dataflow diagram, list of third-party libs in the model bundle, and KMS plan to security-review@redwood.com. I’ll triage within 48h of receiving them.

ajay (eng): Will attach the perf mini-runbook and PR diff. Creating feature branch `feat/kv-prefetch-hel-demo`.

maria (prod): Quick launch criteria (draft):
```
- infra slot reserved + prewarm validated
- runtime change behind feature flag deployed to canary
- security signoff on model artifacts & KMS config
- perf: p99 <= 140ms in canary (target 120ms)
- rollback plan + documented fallback to hosted model
```
If any item slips we escalate.

kevin (infra): Noted. Posting slot reservation + runbook link in ~20m.

ajay (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1234 — includes local perf: p99 118ms with prewarm (8k context).

sasha (runtime): Nice numbers. After canary deploy we’ll run the smoke + perf pipeline and confirm. If metrics look good, we greenlight the demo.

maria (prod): Thanks all. Next actions: ajay ping on merge; lin confirm receipt of security email; kevin post runbook link. I’ll tell Helios the demo is tentative until canary results are green. :white_check_mark:
